description: A People Operations Director must decide whether to approve a job-share arrangement for Nadia, select the operating partner, and set safeguards that will preserve reliable coverage while reducing recurring interpersonal strain on the operations team.

shared_context.S1: Nadia has requested a job-share arrangement for the operations coordinator role because the team needs dependable coverage across the full workday.
shared_context.S2: Jules is the only team member currently being considered as the job-share partner.
shared_context.S3: The operations coordinator role handles daily queue assignments, internal escalations, and handoffs between the morning and afternoon work periods.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding decision on the arrangement and its operating terms.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal arrangement review, Elena first asks Nadia to state her exact schedule constraint, then asks the proposed partner, manager, and HR partner to state their relevant observations and requirements before she finalizes the decision.

PF1.text: Nadia can reliably work from 8:00 a.m. through exactly 3:30 p.m. on weekdays and cannot take scheduled duties after 3:30 p.m.; she has not yet given Elena the exact end time because her initial request only described the need for a reduced afternoon schedule.

PF2.text: Jules has agreed in a private conversation with Nadia to cover the role from 3:30 p.m. through 5:00 p.m. on weekdays and has previously completed structured daily handoffs; Jules has not formally recorded this agreement.

PF3.text: Marcus documented two prior tense one-to-one exchanges between Nadia and Jules about urgent handoffs, so the arrangement should require a shared written handoff tracker and a weekly three-person check-in rather than relying on direct verbal escalation; Marcus kept this in his management notes while waiting for the arrangement review.

PF4.text: Tara confirmed this week that the job-share policy requires a written responsibility charter, voluntary consent from both participants, and a formal review exactly 30 calendar days after launch; the policy confirmation has not yet been added to the request packet.

acceptance_conditions: The job-share must be approved with Jules as Nadia's partner.
Nadia's scheduled responsibility must end at exactly 3:30 p.m., with Jules covering the remaining afternoon period.
The arrangement must use a shared written handoff tracker and a weekly three-person check-in.
The responsibility charter must be required.
The formal review must occur exactly 30 calendar days after launch.
The settlement must include either separate responsibility-charter and formal-review commitments or one policy-compliance commitment that explicitly covers both requirements.

content_checks.C4: decisions['handoff_safeguard'] in ['Shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in (Elena, Nadia, Jules) instead of direct verbal escalation between Nadia and Jules', 'Shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in (Nadia, Jules, Marcus)', 'Shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in (Nadia, Jules, Marcus)', 'Shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in (Nadia, Jules, Marcus) instead of relying on direct verbal escalation', 'Shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in (Nadia, Jules, Marcus); no reliance on direct verbal escalation between Nadia and Jules']
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['responsibility_charter', 'written_responsibility_charter', 'policy_compliance'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: Nadia's exact 3:30 p.m. availability changes the arrangement from an unspecified job-share proposal to an approved schedule with Nadia ending at 3:30 p.m.
Jules's stated willingness and prior handoff experience change the partner choice from an unresolved proposal to Jules.
The two prior tense one-to-one exchanges change the safeguard from ordinary verbal coordination to a shared written handoff tracker and weekly three-person check-in.
The confirmed job-share policy changes the plan by requiring a responsibility charter, setting the review at exactly 30 days, and requiring a policy-compliance commitment covering those requirements.
